events.label: Наука
entries: 2006 – Grigori Perelman is awarded the Fields Medal for his proof of the Poincaré conjecture in mathematics but refuses to accept the medal.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 2004 – Versions of The Scream and Madonna, two paintings by Edvard Munch, are stolen at gunpoint from a museum in Oslo, Norway.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1639 – Madras (now Chennai), India, is founded by the British East India Company on a sliver of land bought from local Nayak rulers.
1846 – The Second Federal Republic of Mexico is established.
1902 – The Cadillac Motor Company is founded.
